name: etch
description: 本地英中双语硬字幕工作站
author: bingjiang0611

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.e2e:hermetic: npm run build && playwright test e2e/electron.spec.ts e2e/bilibili.spec.ts
scripts.smoke:installed: npm run pack && playwright test e2e/installed-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.pack: npm run build && electron-builder --dir --arm64 && npm run verify:pack
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 && npm run verify:dmg
scripts.verify:l1: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
